claim_boundary: This finite-reservoir intervention establishes orientation dependence within the tested rank-one collective-lowering sector. It does not establish universal optimality of the equal-phase direction, an asymptotic scaling law, or a unique microscopic mediator.

coherent_processor.coupling_distribution: For each paired reservoir, complete-graph J_ij values are drawn independently from U[-1,1] and multiplied by sqrt(4/(N-1)).
coherent_processor.hamiltonian: H(s)=sum_{i<j} J_ij X_i X_j + h sum_i Z_i + h(1+s) sum_i X_i

convergence.selection_rule: Use the first common checkpoint at which both conditions pass; all 24 pairs selected 800 inputs.

dissipator.changed_coordinate: Only the direction of the real rank-one collective-lowering coefficient vector is changed relative to the uniform site profile of the fixed Hamiltonian input drive and the otherwise fixed coherent processor.
dissipator.reference_direction_definition: The reference vector (1,1,1,1,1,1) is the uniform site coefficient profile of the Hamiltonian input-drive operator sum_i X_i; it is not the scalar temporal input sequence.
dissipator.terminology_note: The matched five-dimensional object is the kernel of the 6x6 Kossakowski coefficient block, not a five-dimensional many-body dark subspace. For either coefficient vector, the represented 64x64 lowering operator has a 20-dimensional kernel.

inference.primary_estimand: paired equal-phase minus drive-orthogonal STM capacity
inference.primary_interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval across 24 paired reservoir instances
inference.status_rule: orientation dependence is supported only if every convergence audit passes and the primary interval excludes zero

input_and_randomization.seed_note: These are 24 separately generated N=6 paired reservoir instances. Numeric seed identifiers are not described as globally fresh because some identifiers occur in an earlier pilot protocol.
input_and_randomization.stream_partition: NumPy SeedSequence([2026081201, seed]).spawn(4) supplies coupling, washout-input, task-input, and Haar-state streams in that order.

legacy_protocol_hashes.explanation: The frozen runner serialized raw numerical null eigenvalues from np.linalg.eigvalsh into its protocol hash. Two BLAS-backend-dependent roundoff variants therefore occur even though the stable semantic protocol and all scientific invariants are identical.

readout.features: All 18 single-site Pauli expectations and all 45 same-axis two-site Pauli expectations.

response_diagnostic.scope: Normalized response-energy concentration is supporting evidence only; it is not treated as a demonstrated mediator of the STM effect.

status: confirmatory protocol frozen before task trajectories

task.metric: sum over delays of squared-correlation STM capacity
